purpose: Second-stage handoff for Claude Code to rebuild the Claude-created HomeOps AI app with premium UI and real adapter infrastructure.

source_audit.build_after_npm_ci: npm run build succeeded after dependencies were installed
major_findings: README explicitly states demo adapters only and no backend required.
Connections UI includes 'Authorize (demo)' and describes demo authorization.
Seed data includes demo providers, demo URLs, demo webhook URLs, demo browser workflows, and disabled placeholder AI providers.
Workflow templates repeatedly refer to demo connections.
UI structure is functional but generic: left sidebar, simple card grid, low emotional product quality, limited family operating-system feel.
Current architecture is frontend/local-first; real OAuth, webhooks, background jobs, cloud browser sessions, and secret storage require backend/runtime additions.

non_negotiables: Loopback gates block premature success claims
